item.description:
New Fable Class Models Announced in September Sponsor Newsletter

On 3rd October 2026 the author announced that the September edition of the sponsor‑only monthly newsletter had been sent, highlighting a fresh batch of Fable class models.

🔍 Overview

  • The newsletter is distributed only to sponsors.
  • It was sent on 3 October 2026 and covers the latest AI‑related developments.

🆕 New Fable Class Models

  • The headline AI development this month is “More Fable class models”.
  • No further technical detail is provided; the announcement is limited to the inclusion of these models in the newsletter.

📄 Newsletter Content

The newsletter lists the following topics for this month:

  • More Fable class models
  • A pricing war
  • 3D graphics, Blender, and pixel art
  • LLMs come for mathematics
  • So many more accidental cyberattacks
  • The vulnapocalypse comes for Datasette
  • What I’m using right now
  • My software releases this month
  • 2026 in LLMs (so far)

🔑 Access for Sponsors

  • The newsletter is sponsor‑only; sponsors (or new sponsors) can access it via the provided link.
  • A preview of the August newsletter is offered as an example of what subscribers receive.

💰 Pricing

  • Sponsorship costs $10 / month and promises to keep subscribers “a month ahead of the free copy.”

📰 Recent Articles (for context)

  • “We’re going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything” – 3 Oct 2026
  • “OpenAI DevDay 2026 live blog” – 29 Sep 2026
  • “2026 in LLMs (so far)” – 27 Sep 2026
